environment_deviation: Cookiecutter public metadata specifies Python 3.6.9 and tox. This preflight uses pinned official Python 3.6.15, directly runs the metadata's one-line pytest node under pytest 5.4.3, and omits the invalid pkg-resources==0.0.0 editable-requirement entry. It is not an exact historical tox environment. No LLM outcome informed this profile. Debian Buster uses archive mirrors. The public repository's test_requirements.txt declares pytest-cov, pytest-mock, pytest-catchlog, and freezegun; compatible versions and coverage are pinned.
